partially_covered.missing: Organization details are still limited to Address, Identifier, and Role. No explicit data properties for organization name, tax ID, or contact information.
Invoice details such as reference numbers, due dates, and payment terms are not explicitly modeled. Only hasDate, hasInvoiceNumber, and hasTotalAmount are present.

cq_coverage.details: The ontology continues to address most competency questions through its structure, but lacks enrichment for organization metadata and full invoice header fields. CQ5 and CQ10 remain only partially addressed.

strengths: Good use of property restrictions and inverses
weaknesses: No GCAs or equivalentClass axioms for key concepts
Organization and invoice metadata remain underspecified

likely_oops_pitfalls: P7 (Missing inverse properties for some relations)
reasoner_risks: Potential performance issues with many inverses and restrictions; otherwise no OWL 2 DL violations

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add explicit data properties for organization metadata (e.g., organizationName, taxIdentifier, contactDetails) and for invoice header fields (e.g., referenceNumber, dueDate, paymentTerms) to fully address CQ5 and CQ10.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Full coverage of all CQs and richer, standards-aligned data extraction.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Introduce GCAs (General Class Axioms) or owl:equivalentClass axioms to define key classes (e.g., BuyerRole, InvoiceLine) in terms of their necessary and sufficient conditions.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improved reasoning, validation, and semantic clarity.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Expand disjointness axioms to cover more mutually exclusive classes (e.g., AgentRole vs. Segment, Item vs. Address) for stricter validation.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Reduced risk of data modeling errors.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add further annotation properties such as rdfs:seeAlso or skos:definition for external standards alignment (e.g., EN 16931-1 references).

summary: The ontology remains robust and OWL 2 compliant, with strong coverage of EDIFACT invoice structure and most competency questions. However, previous suggestions to enrich organization and invoice metadata have not been implemented, leaving CQ5 and CQ10 only partially addressed. No new issues were introduced, and overall quality and coverage scores are unchanged.

suggestions_ignored: Add explicit data properties for organization metadata and invoice header fields
Add further annotation properties for standards alignment
improvement_tracking.notes: No substantive changes were made since the last review; prior improvement suggestions remain outstanding. The ontology is stable and well-structured but needs further enrichment to fully meet domain requirements.
